rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; nine sites across Europe (Aggressotype and MATRICS consortia); fMRI final analysis from five sites.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "MRI scans were performed in nine different sites across Europe."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort drawn exclusively from the in-house EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects; no EPD from the established list reported.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Participants in the current study were part of the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects."

rci3_epd_name.detail: No EPDs used; reference cohort is fully in-house.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Participants in the current study were part of the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; whole cohort (both TD controls and DBD cases) used as reference under 10-fold cross-validation. model-1: n=129 (77 cases + 52 controls); model-2: n=127 (2 excluded due to bad image quality from n=129).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "A model of brain development as a function of age and sex was created by training a Gaussian process regression (GPR) model... on a sample of n = 129 and n = 127 (77 cases, Table 1)... Here, we used the whole cohort (both TD and DBD) as a reference... GPR predictions are derived in an unbiased manner under 10-fold cross-validation."
rci5_n.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Method / Constructing normative models of brain structure and function

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; model-1 male_n aggregated from Table 1 (controls: 34 males, cases: 64 males; total 98 males); female_n inferred as 129 - 98 = 31. model-2 sex breakdown not reported for the n=127 structural sample.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; model-1 weighted mean = (52×13.88 + 77×13.48) / 129 = 13.64; pooled SD computed from within-group SS: (51×2.44² + 76×2.58²) / 127 = 6.374, SD = 2.52; age range from study description (years). model-2 age statistics not reported for the n=127 structural sample.
rci7_age.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Abstract / Methods; Holz2023.pdf.md: Table 1. Sample characteristics
